As per AICTE Regulation No. 1-101/PGRC/AICTE/Regulation/2019 dated 19.11.2019, provision has been made for Establishment of a Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) by the institution and appointment of OMBUDSPERSON by all the affiliating Technological Universities for the purpose of redressal of grievances of the students, parents and others. Accordingly, each technical Institution shall establish a registry, headed by an employee of the concerned Institution to receive the grievances, where an aggrieved student or person shall send their representation for redressal of their grievance. Therefore, all aggrieved students, their parents & others may henceforth approach the Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) of the Institution, in the first instance, and if they are not satisfied with the decision of the committee, they may send their appeals to the OMBUDSPERSON directly.

As per the grievance of the assessee, he has declared income from other sources of Rs.8,92,143/- and claimed deduction of Rs. 5,48,146/- as interest paid on above income resulting into net income from other sources of Rs. 3,43,997/-. He has received interest of Rs 8,52,867/- from M/s Rise Eleven Ready-mix Pvt. Ltd. during F.Y. 2020-21 and TDS u/s 194A was deducted by the M/s Rise Eleven Ready-mix Pvt. Further, as per assessee he has paid interest of Rs.2,08,758/- to M/s Vishal Ready-mix and Rs 3,39,388/-for Housing Loan top up. The assessee has claimed deduction of Rs. 5,48,146/- u/s 57 of the Act.
However, the CPC restricted the credit of TDS – proportionately to the interest income declared by the assessee. Now the assessee is requesting for credit of full TDS of Rs. 2,73,805 /- claimed in the ITR. As this matter does not come under the ambit of rectification u/s 154 because it not a mistake apparent from record rather it is an issue-based grievance. The complainant /assessee may file an appeal against the order passed by the CPC. Hence, no action is pending at the end of this office and the grievance stands disposed

OfficerDetail: Suja Menon V (Income Tax Officer CPC ITR)
remarks:
Dear Sir/Madam, 

It is seen from CPC portal for AY 2021-22, taxpayers rectification request has been processed with demand of Rs.91,452/-, considering taxpayers response to G5 communication ( Defective Notice ). Taxpayer is requested to approch JAO for resolution of grievance. The jurisdictional AO has to make a request for transfer of rights in ITBA using path:Go to ITBA home page - click rectification module - menu tab - initiate rectification proceeds - search with PAN/AY - Search order - Select the order - Initiate Proceedings. Since the webservice functionality for rectification is not enabled in ITBA, JAO has to mandatorily seek the rectification rights by intiating the rectification proceedings in ITBA,after which the rights will get transferred to JAO. JAO has to pass rectification order through Manual order functionality only. Hence, the grievance is transferred to concerned JAO for verification of the claim of the taxpayer and resolution of the grievance.

The assessee had filed his return of income for AY 2014-15 on 15.07.2015 admitting a total income of Rs. 5,39,530. The case was selected for scrutiny in August, 2016 and assessment order u/s 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 was passed with an addition of Rs. 25,52,680 on 08th December, 2016. 

The assessee, then preferred an appeal against the said order with CIT appeals and paid Rs. 1,61,090 as deposit of tax in lieu of the appeal filed on 16th February, 2017. CIT Appeals dismissing the appeal of the assessee vide order dated 3rd October, 2017. 

Aggrieved by the order, the assessee preferred an appeal to The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT). The ITAT pronounced its judgement on 04th July, 2018 remanding back the case to Assessing Officer for fresh consideration. But by this time, the tax that was demanded and in dispute to the tune of Rs. 10,61,090 had been already remitted to the government by the assessee. The case then was remanded back to the Assessing officer.

The Assessing officer had given fresh consideration as directed by the ITAT and passed an assessment order u/s 143(3) read with Sec 254 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 dt. 23rd December, 2019. In this order, the AO had removed the addition and completed the assessment. The income filed originally in the return of income by the assessee was held to be correct and final and all the additions were deleted. Therefore, the assessee becomes eligible for a refund of all the taxes paid earlier in lieu of the older addition which now stood deleted. The refund claimed by the assessee has been issued after obtaining approval from Range Head (screen shot attached). Hence the CPGRAM grievance is treated as settled.

The grievance of the assessee is that although he is eligible for refund on processing his return of income for the AY 2022-23, this refund is being adjusted against the bogus demands created for AYs 2013-14 to 2018-19. In these assessments the payments made by assessee as prepaid taxes and regular tax payments had not been given credit in the tax computation by CPC-ITR resulting in bogus demand for the AYs 2013-14 to 2018-19. The Assessment Order U/s 153C of the Income Tax Act, 1961 for the AYs 2013-14 to 2018-19 was made on 17-03-2022. But due to technical glitches in ITBA/CPC credit for prepaid taxes/regular tax payments (paid after December 2021) were not given credit and hence resulted in bogus demand for the AYs 2013-14 to 2015-16 & 2018-19. Assessee filed rectification application on 07-04-2022. Since this is a mistake apparent from records, the assessment order u/s 153C were subjected to rectification proceedings. For the AY 2013-14 rectification computation was successful as there is no SAT/RAT payments during 2022 and was rectified on 27-06-2022. But for AYs 2014-15, 2015-16 & 2018-19 prepaid taxes and the adjusted refund for the AY 2022-23 as the regular taxes were not given credit by CPC in rectification computation. Later assessee filed CPGRAMS application on 19-01-2023. Credit for Self Asst. Tax/Regular assessment tax was still not given by CPC when rectification computation was initiated on 20-01-2023. Case was referred to CPC for resolution of the issue, even though no responses were received further rectification initiated on 24-02-2023, but the same issue persisted. Further the rectification computation for the AYs done on 24-03-2023 as per the direction from DGIT(Systems) and credits for the prepaid taxes are fully matched, but due to technical error in ITBA rectification order could not be generated. (Screen shot attached as pdf). As this issue pertaining to ITBA/CPC-ITR, rectification order can be passed only after the issue is resorted.

 जांच प्रतिवेदन अनुसार मनरेगा योजनान्तर्गत जिला पंचायत धार में वर्ष 2020-21 में राशि रूपये 290.23 करोड रूपये एवं वर्ष 2021-22 में राशि रूपये 258.44 करोड़ रूपये का मजदूरी भुगतान मजदूरों के खाते में किया गया है, ऐसे श्रमिक जिनका परिषद के पत्र क्रमांक 5231/एनआर-1/2020 दिनांक 07.12.2020 में दिये गये दिशा निर्देशानुसार जाबकार्ड विलोपन के पूर्व जिला कार्यक्रम समन्वयक (कलेक्टर महोदय) से अनुमोदन लिया जाना था किन्तु जनपद पंचायत द्वारा विलोपित योग्य‍ जाबकार्ड की सूची जिला स्तर पर प्रेषित न कर बिना अनुमोदन प्राप्त किये ही 107340 जाबकार्ड विलोपित किये गये थे। इस कृत्य के लिए समस्त कार्यक्रम अधिकारी जनपद पंचायत, अतिरिक्त् कार्यक्रम अधिकारी जनपद पंचायत, सहायक लेखाधिकारी जनपद पंचायत एवं संबंधित ग्राम पंचायतों के सचिव एवं ग्राम रोजगार सहायकों पर मनरेगा अधिनियम 2005 की धारा 25 के तहत अर्थदण्ड अधिरोपित करते हुए भविष्य में इसकी पुनरावृति नही करने के संबंध में चेतावनी पत्र भी जारी किया गया है। प्रकरण में वसूली की कार्यवाही प्रचलित है, दिनांक 01.01.2023 से समस्त सामुदायिक कार्यों पर उपस्थित दर्ज करने हेतु NMMS अनिवार्य कर दिया गया है, इस हेतु समस्त जिलों को निर्देशित किया गया है।

Transfer guidelines issued on 31.12.2021 relate to manual processing of transfer requests, which include following 3 stages:-
a)	Forwarding of transfer request to transferee unit
b)	Receipt of accommodation report from transferee unit
c)	Approval of transfer and Relieving of official by home unit
Accordingly, the criteria of 66.66 percentage was being observed by the home unit while considering approval of transfer and relieving of official.
As transfer requests are now considered in an automated system, receipt accommodation, observance of 66.66 percentage criteria and approval of transfer request are considered simultaneously in that order and after approval the official is relieved in a time bound manner. 
Thus, the grievance is purely an interpretation issue and there is no deviation from the guidelines.

It is seen from CPC portal for AY 2021-22, taxpayers rectification return has been processed on 29/07/2022 determining a demand of Rs.86,743/-, after making necessary adjustments u/s 143(1)(a) as per provisions of Income Tax Act and details submitted in response to PFA notice. Since the webservice functionality for rectification is not enabled in ITBA, JAO has to mandatorily seek the rectification rights by intiating the rectification proceedings in ITBA,after which the rights will get transferred to JAO. Hence, the grievance is transferred to concerned JAO for verification of the claim of the taxpayer and resolution of the grievance.

Hence, the grievance is transferred to concerned JAO for verification of the claim of the taxpayer and resolution of the grievance.

The assessee has filed CPGRAMS grievance requesting for issue for refund for the A.Y. 2020-21 which was received in this office on 08.03.2023 on being transferred from various authorities.
2.	The grievance has been considered carefully. On verification, it is noticed that the assessee has filed original return for the A.Y. 2020-21 on 29.12.2020 by declaring total income at Rs. 9,96,256/- wherein neither refund nor relief u/s 90 was claimed. The same was processed u/s 143(1) on 07.1.2021. Thereafter, the assessee has revised his return for the A.Y. 2020-21 on 31.03.2021 declaring total income at Rs. 2,7,79,450/- and refund of Rs. 20 only was claimed on account of tax relief of Rs. 4,35,255/- u/s 90 on account of DTAA. The said return was verified by the assessee through duly signed ITR-V form much after the due date on 02.08.2021. Still the return was processed u/s 143(1) on 25.09.2021 where the CPC has taken into consideration the claim of the assessee u/s 90 and disallowed the same. Thereafter, the application filed by the assessee requesting for rectification u/s 154 was processed by the CPC on 24.08.2022 wherein relief claimed by the assessee was disallowed once again. The claim of the assessee is required to be verified before granting him relief. In view of the above, the same is not a mistake apparent of record and cannot be rectified u/s 154 of the I.T. Act, 1961. Moreover, no rectification application u/s 154 has been received in this office with supporting documentary evidences. The assessee may file appeal before the Ld. CIT(A) against the rectification order u/s 154. As such, no action is pending at the level of the AO, the grievance may be treated as settled in respect of this charge.

 (ર) 	આપશ્રી ની અરજીમાં રજુઆત કરવામાં આવેલ મુદામાં કોઈ તથ્ય નથી અને વધુમાં આ અંગે કોઈ પુરાવા પણ આપેલ નથી. માત્ર પાયા વિહોણા આક્ષેપ કરવામાં આવેલ છે. ખરેખર આ બાબત કોઈ તથ્ય જણાતું નથી. 
(૩) 	અરજીની રજુઆતમાં જણાવ્યા મુજબ વિવિધ મુદાઓમાં ખોટા આક્ષેપો કરેલ છે. સોસાયટીના દરેક મકાનને જોડતા રોડમાં લાઈટ, પાણીની સુવિધા આપવામાં આવે છે. તેમજ સોસાયટીના નકશાઓ એ ટાઉન પ્લાનર / સરકારશ્રી ધ્વારા મંજુર કરવામાં આવતા હોય છે. જે મુજબ કોમન પ્લોટ અને રસ્તાઓ તેમાં છોડેલા હોય છે. ઈરાદાપૂર્વક સાર્વજનિક પ્લોટમાં રસ્તા બનાવવા બાબતે જણાવવાનું કે સોસાયટીના સાર્વજનિક પ્લોટ અને રસ્તાઓ જે તે વખતે જે તે મુળ જમીન માલિક ધ્વારા લેખિત નગર પાલિકાને સુપ્રત કરેલા હોય છે અને નગર પાલિકાએ સંભાળેલા છે. જેથી ત્યારબાદ જ નગર પાલિકા લાઈટ પાણીની સુવિધા પુરી પાડે છે. 
તેમજ વધુમાં અન્ય નવા રોડ રસ્તા બનાવવા બાબતે જણાવવાનું કે – આપ જે વોર્ડના રહે છે તે વોર્ડના સદસ્યશ્રી ધ્વારા જે કામ સામાન્ય સભામાં રજુઆત કરવામાં આવે કે સુચન કરવામાં આવે તે કામો સામાન્ય સભામાં ચૂંટાયેલા સદસ્યશ્રીઓ ધ્વારા મંજુર થતા હોય છે. જેથી આગામી સમયમાં અરજદારના વોર્ડના સદસ્યશ્રી ધ્વારા અરજદાર ધ્વારા સુચિત કામની રજુઆત કરવામાં આવ્યેથી અને ત્યારબાદ સામાન્ય સભામાં નિર્ણય થયેથી આગળની કાર્યવાહી કરવામાં આવશે.

The subject matter of the grievance petition is related to Waiver of recovery on account of withdrawal of 3rd MACP in the GP of Rs.6600 granted to various officers. The petitioner has mentioned that he superannuated as Assistant Commissioner on 31.01.2019 from the office of the Principal Chief Commissioner, Bangalore. At the time of his superannuation on 31.01.2019, an amount of Rs.4,45,000/- was ordered to be recovered from the amount of gratuity/pay, due to me, on account of alleged excess amount paid to me, owing to wrong fixation of Grade Pay of Rs.6,600/- (granted to me after completion of 30 years of service). The said 3rd MACP, which was due to me on 24.12.2012 after 30 years of service was granted to me in the year 2014 and later due to the conflicting opinions of the DOPT, the same was recovered. Further, the petitioner has mentioned that CBIC has desired a report of all such cases, my case, along with all such cases, may kindly be ordered to be sent to them. I submit that my case of grant of 3rd MACP in the GP of Rs.6,600/- on completion of 30 years of service on 24.12.2012 was very well covered under the existing guidelines, issued by the DOPT vide O,M dated 19.05.2009 and admissible under Para 11 read with Para 28C of Annexure-I of the MACPs. The officers, who processed my case andsanctioned the 3rd MACP, were genuinely and legally correct in their view. Later on , it was a matter of interpretation on the part of the PAO and the CBIC that a Circular dated 20.06.2016 was issued by the CBIC to downgrade GP of RS.6,600/- to Rs.5,400/- in PB-3 by counting NFG as one MACP. The aforesaid Circular dated 20.06.2016 was applied in utter disregard of Para 11 read with Para 28C of MACPS.4. Hence, the petitioner has requested that an amount of Rs.4,45,000/-, recovered from his gratuity/pay on 31.01.2019, may be ordered to be paid.

remarks: The location mentioned in the petition is at Bonpuroi Jamuguri area. There was a severe erosion at Bonpuroi-Jamuguri in the embankment, Jamuguri to Kharoi outfall in the year 2020. As such, as an emergent measure, some of the registered contractors of the Water Resources Department carried out some temporary palliative works at their own risk and in the presence of the then MLA, Executive Engineer, North Lakhimpur W.R. Division and Assistant Executive Engineer, Bihpuria W.R. Sub-Division, Bihpuria. The petitioners were most likely engaged with the registered contractors. But the petitioners are not the registered contractors of Water Resources Department. No work orders were issued in the name of the petitioners. Without higher officers concerned, no verbal instructions were given by the Assistant Executive Engineer, Bihpuria W.R. Sub-Division, Bihpuria to the petitioners for execution of the works. Though an M&R estimate amounting to Rs. 15,00,000.00 was sanctioned for the mentioned location, payment could not be made due to election code of conduct. As such, no work orders were issued to the said contractors for the year 2020. Later on, the above-mentioned registered contractors were allotted works under M&R head for the year 2021-22 and payment was made as per work orders and works carried out at site.

Suggestions/request has been examined . In this regard it is stated that the condition of Polycythaemia Vera is a medical condition whereas RPwD Act, 2016 mainly focuses on disability. A High Powered Inter-Department Committee constituted under the ambit of RPwD Act, 2016 in its meeting held on 10.01.2018 considered the condition of Polycythaemia Vera in the list of specified disabilities and was of the view that there is clear distinction between disability and medical condition. So if a person suffering from a certain disease condition develops any of the specified disabilities mentioned in the schedule of the RPwD Act, 2016, is already covered within the ambit of the said Act. It is further stated that the High Powered Committee recommended not include medical conditions as specified Disability per se, in the Schedule to the RPwD Act, 2016. 
In view of the above, your request is disposed off.

remarks: With reference to the instant grievance, the following points may be noted. 1. The coverage of the establishment is w.e.f 15/02/1992 under the Family Pension Scheme, 1971. 2 The Employees Pension Scheme, 1995 has come into effect from 16/11/1995. 3. The date on which the member attained superannuation, i.e exited the Employees Pension Scheme, 1995 is on 27/10/2000. 4. Hence the total eligible service is 8 years 8 months 28 days, which is less than 10 years. 5. The Member has claimed that she was working in the establishment from 01/03/1985. However, her establishment was not coverable under the Family Pension Scheme, 1971 on the said date and was eligible to covered only w.e.f 15/02/1992 as per the scheme provisions. In view of above, though the employee may have rendered more than 10 years service, her eligible service shall be counted only from the date from which the establishment itself was coverable under the scheme. As the establishment was coverable and covered w.e.f 15/02/1995, the eligible service is only 8 years 8 months 28 days which is less than 10 years. Hence the member was not eligible for pension under Employees Pension Scheme, 1995 and given withdrawal benefit.

अवगत कराना है की शिकायतकर्ता से प्राप्त प्रपत्र नियोक्ता से सत्यापित न होने एवं नियोजन सम्बंधित दस्तावेज संलग्न ना होने के कारण इस कार्यालय द्वारा प्रवर्तन अधिकारी को नियोक्ता से संपर्क कर उचित कारवाही हेतु निर्देशित किया गया था जिसके अनुक्रम में प्रवर्तन अधिकारी ने अपनी अंतिम रिपोर्ट में सूचित किया है की नियोक्ता की मृत्यु हो गयी है एवं उनकी पत्नी ने अवगत कराया है की उनके पास प्रतिष्ठान से सम्बंधित कोई भी दस्तावेज उपलब्ध नहीं है l उपरोक्त स्थिति में शिकायतकर्ता से अनुरोध है की कृपया वह मुख्यालय के सर्कुलर संख्या 2874 दिनांक 12/02/2021 (सर्कुलर संलग्न है ) के अनुसार नियोजन सम्बन्धी दस्तावेज जैसे नियुक्ति पत्र, वेतन पर्ची, वेतन वृद्धि पत्र इत्यादि इस कार्यालय में प्रेषित करे ताकि अग्रिम कार्यवाही की जा सके l शिकायतकर्ता को प्रेषित पत्र एवं सर्कुलर की प्रति संलग्न है l

As per the policy decided by the Ministry of Education and JEE Apex Board, JEE (Main) – 2023 is going to be conducted in two Sessions i.e. Session 1 (24 to 31 January 2023) and Session 2 (06 to 12 April 2023) to support the students’ community in the following ways:

In JEE (Main) – 2022, an opportunity was provided to the candidates to improve their scores if they were not able to give their best in one attempt by conducting two sessions.

i.	In the first attempt, the Candidates will get a first-hand experience of taking an examination and can know their mistakes which they can improve while attempting for the next time. 

ii.	In the first, and second attempts, the Candidates will also be well versed in the pattern and method of examination. 

iii.	It will reduced the chances of dropping a year and droppers would not have to waste a full year.

iv.	If anyone misses the examination due to reasons beyond control (such as the Board examination, health issues, etc.), then he/she did will not have to wait for one full year.

v.	Moreover, there is no need for a candidate to appear in both Sessions. However, if a candidate appears in both the Session then his/her best of the 2023 NTA Scores will be considered for preparation of Merit List/ Ranking.

For further clarification regarding JEE (Main) – 2023, candidates can write at NTA at jeemain@nta.ac.in

रक्षा मंत्रालय में आपकी शिकायत के संदर्भ में, DMA(AG), रक्षा मंत्रालय, भारतीय सेना कर्मियों की सेवा के संबंध में नीतियों के लिए जिम्मेदार है। भारतीय सेना के सेवारत कर्मियों द्वारा आचरण के उल्लंघन को गंभीरता से देखा जाता है और अपराधियों के खिलाफ आवश्यक अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई शुरू की जाती है। आपके द्वारा लाया गया मामला सिविल पुलिस शिकायत से संबंधित है। चूंकि मामला पुलिस और अदालत के विचाराधीन है, इस मामले पर सेना अधिकारियों द्वारा साथ साथ निर्णय नहीं किया जा सकता है। 
आपकी शिकायत वैवाहिक कलह के संबंध में है और पहले ही AWWA द्वारा हस्तक्षेप की मांग की जा चुकी है। इसके अलावा, पुलिस अधिकारियों द्वारा मामले की जांच की जा रही है। उल्लेखनीय है कि AWWA कल्याणकारी निकाय है जो रक्षा मंत्रालय के चार्टर के अधीन नहीं है।

कानून प्रवर्तन एजेंसियों द्वारा निर्णय प्राप्त होने पर सेना अधिनियम के अनुसार आवश्यक कार्रवाई की जाएगी। इसके बावजूद आपकी शिकायत को नोट कर लिया गया है और आवश्यक कार्रवाई के लिए सेना मुख्यालय भेजा जा रहा है।

वर्ष 2023 के अवसर पर मिली आपकी शुभकामनाओं के लिए आभार। आपको व आपके परिवार को इस साल की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं। देशवासियों से मिलने वाला स्नेह मुझे राष्ट्र की उन्नति के लिए नई ऊर्जा के साथ काम करने की प्रेरणा देता है।
कहा गया है- ‘परिमितं भूतम् अपरिमितं भव्यम्।’ अर्थात् भूत काल सीमित होता है, जबकि भविष्य असीमित है। विगत वर्ष की स्मृत्तियों और चुनौतियों से सीखते हुए हमें निरंतर आगे बढ़ना है और देश की उन्नति के लिए मिलकर कार्य करना है।
देश की आजादी का अमृत काल हम सभी के लिए आत्मनिर्भर व भव्य भारत के विराट संकल्पों की सिद्धि के लिए जी-जान से कार्य करने का कर्तव्य काल है। मुझे विश्वास है कि इस अवसर पर ‘राष्ट्र प्रथम, सदैव प्रथम’ के भाव के साथ आपके प्रयास देश व समाज की प्रगति सुनिश्चित करेंगे।
ईश्वर से प्रार्थना है कि यह वर्ष आपके जीवन में सकारात्मक बदलावों, लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति व सफलता का एक अविस्मरणीय साल बने। एक बार फिर से आपको व आपके परिवार को वर्ष 2023 की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ।
आपके अच्छे स्वास्थ्य व उज्ज्वल भविष्य की कामना सहित।

आपके द्वारा वर्णित प्रतिवेदन के संबंध में आपको सूचित किया जाता है कि, CEN RRC 01/2019 (लेवल-1) में NORMALIZATION एवं CBT के परिणाम विस्तृत केंद्रीकृत रोजगार अधिसूचना सं. RRC 01/2019 व इसमें समय-समय पर जारी संशोधनों के अंतर्गत निहित प्रावधानों के अनुसार ही जारी किये गये हैं। इससे संबंधित महत्वपूर्ण सूचनाएँ भी आवेदकों के लिए रेलवे भर्ती बोर्डों की वेबसाइटों पर उपलब्ध है। कृपया CEN RRC 01/2019 में CCAA के संबंध उपलब्ध प्रावधानों, पैरा सं.-6.0 का नोट, 9.7,12.0 इत्यादि तथा रेलवे भर्ती बोर्ड, भोपाल की वेबसाइट पर उपलब्ध नोटिस दिनांक 22.07.2022, 31.07.2022 तथा 08.09.2022 का भी इस संबंध में अवलोकन करें जिसके अनुसार CEN RRC 01/2019 के अंतर्गत CBT में CCAA के आवेदकों की शार्टलिस्टिंग की गई है। कृपया ध्यानपूर्वक जांच लें कि आप उपरोक्त में वर्णित पात्रता शर्तों को पूरा करते हैं और आपके NCVT प्रमाण पत्र में “MARKS” उपलब्ध हैं और उनको आपने उपरोक्त नोटिसों के द्वारा RRB वेबसाइट पर प्रदान किये गये लिंक के माध्यम से दी गई समयावधि के भीतर अपलोड किया था। फिर भी शंका होने पर आप संबंधित RRB Office (जिसके द्वारा E-call letter जारी किया गया है) में उपस्थित होकर उसको दूर कर सकते है।

आपको अवगत कराया जाता है कि जवाहर नवोदय विद्यालय एक जिले में, उस जिले के विशेष रूप से ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के छात्रों को गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा प्रदान करने के उद्देश्य से खोले गए हैं। हालांकि चयन परीक्षा राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर आयोजित की जाती है परन्तु जवाहर नवोदय विद्यालय में प्रवेश के लिए छात्रों का चयन केवल संबंधित जिले के उम्मीदवारों में से होता है। कक्षा V उत्तीर्ण करना और उसी जिले का वास्तविक निवासी होना पात्रता शर्तों में से एक है। यदि किसी अन्य जिले के उम्मीदवार को प्रवेश दिया जाता है, तो इससे संबंधित जिले के उन वास्तविक छात्रों के शिक्षा प्राप्त करने के अधिकारों का हनन होता है जिनके लिए जवाहर नवोदय विद्यालय खोले गए हैं ।

2. आपको सूचित किया जाता है कि आपके द्वारा CPGRAMS पोर्टल पर 
Credit Information Bureau (India) Limited के विरुद्ध की गई शिकायत को शिकायत प्रबंध प्रणाली (Complaint Management System) पोर्टल पर शिकायत संख्या N202223023378185 के रूप में दर्ज किया गया था। शिकायत के अवलोकन के पश्चात पाया गया है कि इसी विषय पर वर्तमान में शिकायत सं N202223023379109 हमारे कार्यालय में प्रक्रियाधीन है, जिसपर की गई कार्रवाई से आपको यथानुसार सूचित किया जायेगा। अत: इस शिकायत को अस्‍वीकार्य वर्गीकृत किया गया है और रिज़र्व बैंक - एकीकृत लोकपाल योजना, 2021 के खंड 16(1)(a)10(2)(b)(i), जिसे निम्‍नप्रकार पढा जाए, के तहत बंद किया गया है:

NPPA fixes the ceiling price of scheduled medicines specified in the first schedule of the DPCO, 2013. All manufacturers of scheduled medicines have to sell their products within the ceiling price (plus applicable Taxes) fixed by the NPPA. DPCO, 2013 allows an annual price rise for scheduled formulations based on Wholesale Price Index (WPI). NPPA also fixes retail price of a new drug under DPCO, 2013 for existing manufacturers of scheduled formulation. DPCO, 2013 further mandates monitoring of retail prices in respect of non- scheduled formulations by allowing the increase in MRP up to 10 percent during preceding twelve (12) months. Instances of overcharging are dealt with by NPPA under the relevant provisions of DPCO 2013.ii) With an objective of making generic medicines available at affordable prices to all, Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers in the year 2008. Under the Scheme, dedicated outlets known as Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras (PMBJKs) are opened to provide generic medicines at cheaper rates to the citizens.iii) All price notifications are available on NPPA web-site www.nppaindia.nic.in. The applicant can also search the price of scheduled formulations by using the tool Search Medicine Price available on the website of NPPA or through Mobile App Pharma Sahi Daam.iv) Any price violation of the provisions of DPCO, 2013 a specific complaint may be made to NPPA at monitoring-nppa@gov.in or by using the NPPA portal at Pharma Jan Samadhan, along with copy of the strip/ pack of the medicine and copy of the bill so that appropriate action can be taken against the concerned company.v) The issue raised in the grievance regarding Printing of information on product, GST etc. are not in the purview of NPPA. remarks: भा.खा.नि., मण्डल कार्यालय आगरा के पत्र संख्या ई-10/ भं०/ एस.डब्ल्यू.सी. / सा०पा० / आगरा / 2019-20 दिनांक 21.01.2023 द्वारा शिकायतकर्ता को विस्तृत जबाव प्रेषित किया है। जिसमे यह बताया गया है कि भंडारागार, कोसीकलां जनपद मथुरा में तैनात एन.डब्ल्यू.एन.पी. श्रमिकों की नियुक्ति माननीय न्यायालय के आदेशों की अनुपालना में सुनिश्चित की गयी थी। वर्तमान में डिपो कोसीकला (नया) पर रेक के माध्यम से प्राप्त खाद्यान्न को भंडारित किया जा रहा है इसके साथ ही कोसीकला (पुराना) पर भी शेडों में सिविल कार्य पूर्ण हो जाने के साथ साथ उन शेडों में रेक से प्राप्त खाद्यान्न को भंडारित किया जा रहा है। एसडब्ल्यू०सी० डिपो मथुरा की भंडारण क्षमता 10000 एम.टी. को डिहायर करने की प्रक्रिया आरम्भ कर दी गयी है। इसके अतिरिक्त कोसीकला (पुराना) पर सिविल का कार्य होने की वजह से लगभग 10000 एम०टी० भंडारण क्षमता का उपयोग नहीं हो पा रहा है, वर्तमान में कोसीकला (पुराना) पर दिनांक 17.01.2023 की रिपोर्ट के आधार पर 33600 एम.टी. के सापेक्ष 10359.62 एम०टी० एवं कोसीकला (नया) पर दिनांक 17.01.2023 की रिपोर्ट के आधार 30240 एम.टी. के सापेक्ष 12944. 82. एम.टी. खाद्यान्न भंडारित है, शिकायतकर्ता के द्वारा प्रस्तुत भंडारण क्षमता को देखते हुए भी पूर्ण मंडारण क्षमता का उपयोग श्रमिकों के ना लगाये जाने की वजह से नहीं हो पा रहा है, जो अब रेक के माध्यम से 20 बोरों की ऊंचाई से भरे जा रहे है उसके उपरांत उक्त दोनो डिपो मथुरा जनपद से होने वाले उठान से उठान सुनिश्चित किया जायेगा। शिकायतकर्ता के इस सुझाव पर कार्यवाही जारी है। एसडब्ल्यू०सी० डिपो मथुरा की भंडारण क्षमता 10000 एम.टी. को खाद्यान्न निर्गमन करने के उपरांत जल्द ही डिहायर कर दिया जायेगा। एसडब्ल्यू०सी० डिपो मथुरा पर होने वाली भंडारण हानि के लिए एस.डब्ल्यू. सी. से कटौती की जा रही है जैसे कि पूर्व में भी कटौती मण्डल कार्यालय आगरा के माध्यम से किया जाना सुनिश्चित किया जा चुका है।

In this case, there was earlier grievance that TDS had been deducted by M/s Furnace Fabrica (I) Ltd during FY 2021-22, but not paid to the credit of the Government of India. The deductor was requested vide email dated 28.07.2022 to deposit the TDS at the earliest and asked to show cause as to why proceedings u/s 201 of the Act should not be initiated. Further reminders dtd 12.08.2022 and 17.08.2022 were sent, in response to which, on 18.08.2022 the assessee intimated inability to pay due to severe financial crunch and requested for a month’s time. On 28.09.2022 assessee again expressed inability to remit the TDS and intimated that it was negotiating with lending bank for loan restructuring and requested for two months’ time for making the payment. On 23.11.2022, assessee was asked to intimate by 28.11.2022, the action taken by it in respect of the complaint. However, assessee has not submitted anything in this regard. Therefore, the details of transactions with the assessee were obtained from the complainant himself and it is seen that TDS of Rs.1,09,703/- was deducted but not deposited by the assessee. On account of repeated non-compliance, a notice dated 07.12.2022 was issued whereby the assessee was asked to show cause as to why proceedings u/s. 201(1), 201(1A), 276B should not be initiated in the case. Since no reply was filed by the assessee, on the basis of the material available on record, order u/s 201 of the Act was issued for FY 2021-22 on 13.12.2022 raising demand of Rs.1,32,898/-. In view of the fact that TDS had not been deposited till date, proposal for prosecution is also submitted in this case on 13.12.2022. In view of the above facts and action taken as stated, the grievance was disposed off at this end as settled. 
Since there is no further action to be initiated at the end of this office, the present grievance of the assessee may be treated as settled at this end.

इसके अतिरिक्त सदस्य के नाम correction के दस्तावेज दिनाँक 06/01/2023 को कार्यालय में प्राप्त हुए थे, जिसके अनुसार दिनाँक 09/01/2023 को सदस्य के नाम की correction की जा चुकी है। 
सदस्य को यह भी सूचित किया जाता है कि इस कार्यालय के रिकार्ड के अनुसार उनका KYC भी अपडेट नहीं है। अतः सदस्य member unified portal के माध्यम से अपना KYC भी seed करें । साथ ही अपने भ. नि. खाता संख्या HPSML/2732/4961 के संदर्भ में नौकरी छोड़ने का कारण एवं नौकरी छोड़ने की दिनाँक भी अपने नियोक्ता से अपडेट करवाएं। 
उक्त details अपडेट होने के पश्चात सदस्य भविष्य निधि राशि निकालने के लिए member unified portal के माध्यम से ऑनलइन आवेदन करें। उपरोक्त के संबंध में सदस्य को दूरभाष के माध्यम से सूचित कर दिया गया है । तथा सदस्य ने आश्वासन दिया है कि जैसी उन्हे सूचना दी गई है उसके अनुसार कार्यवाही अमल में लाएगे ।

remarks: IR-S Division, FCI, Hqrs vide letter No.FCI HQ-IRS018/1/2022-IRS dated 18.01.2023 has informed the complainant that as per procedure, Liver Transplant has to be approved by the high level Standing Committee as per FCI Circular No. EP-12-2015-03 dated 09.02.2015. The petitioner has mentioned that he superannuated as Assistant Commissioner on 31.01.2019 from the office of the Principal Chief Commissioner, Bangalore. At the time of his superannuation on 31.01.2019, an amount of Rs.4,45,000/- was ordered to be recovered from the amount of gratuity/pay, due to me, on account of alleged excess amount paid to me, owing to wrong fixation of Grade Pay of Rs.6,600/- (granted to me after completion of 30 years of service). The said 3rd MACP, which was due to me on 24.12.2012 after 30 years of service was granted to me in the year 2014 and later due to the conflicting opinions of the DOPT, the same was recovered. Further, the petitioner has mentioned that CBIC has desired a report of all such cases, my case, along with all such cases, may kindly be ordered to be sent to them. I submit that my case of grant of 3rd MACP in the GP of Rs.6,600/- on completion of 30 years of service on 24.12.2012 was very well covered under the existing guidelines, issued by the DOPT vide O,M dated 19.05.2009 and admissible under Para 11 read with Para 28C of Annexure-I of the MACPs. The officers, who processed my case andsanctioned the 3rd MACP, were genuinely and legally correct in their view. Later on , it was a matter of interpretation on the part of the PAO and the CBIC that a Circular dated 20.06.2016 was issued by the CBIC to downgrade GP of RS.6,600/- to Rs.5,400/- in PB-3 by counting NFG as one MACP. The aforesaid Circular dated 20.06.2016 was applied in utter disregard of Para 11 read with Para 28C of MACPS.4. Hence, the petitioner has requested that an amount of Rs.4,45,000/-, recovered from his gratuity/pay on 31.01.2019, may be ordered to be paid.

The subject matter of the grievance petition is related to Waiver of recovery on account of withdrawal of 3rd MACP in the GP of Rs.6600 granted to various officers. The petitioner has mentioned that he superannuated as Assistant Commissioner on 31.01.2019 from the office of the Principal Chief Commissioner, Bangalore. At the time of his superannuation on 31.01.2019, an amount of Rs.4,45,000/- was ordered to be recovered from the amount of gratuity/pay, due to me, on account of alleged excess amount paid to me, owing to wrong fixation of Grade Pay of Rs.6,600/- (granted to me after completion of 30 years of service). The said 3rd MACP, which was due to me on 24.12.2012 after 30 years of service was granted to me in the year 2014 and later due to the conflicting opinions of the DOPT, the same was recovered. Further, the petitioner has mentioned that CBIC has desired a report of all such cases, my case, along with all such cases, may kindly be ordered to be sent to them. I submit that my case of grant of 3rd MACP in the GP of Rs.6,600/- on completion of 30 years of service on 24.12.2012 was very well covered under the existing guidelines, issued by the DOPT vide O,M dated 19.05.2009 and admissible under Para 11 read with Para 28C of Annexure-I of the MACPs. The officers, who processed my case andsanctioned the 3rd MACP, were genuinely and legally correct in their view. Later on , it was a matter of interpretation on the part of the PAO and the CBIC that a Circular dated 20.06.2016 was issued by the CBIC to downgrade GP of RS.6,600/- to Rs.5,400/- in PB-3 by counting NFG as one MACP. The aforesaid Circular dated 20.06.2016 was applied in utter disregard of Para 11 read with Para 28C of MACPS.4. Hence, the petitioner has requested that an amount of Rs.4,45,000/-, recovered from his gratuity/pay on 31.01.2019, may be ordered to be paid.

 

Since, the subject matter is related to waiver of recovery, hence, the grievance is being transferred to E-II-A branch of DoE.

इसी दौरान डीआरटी एवं डीआरएटी जनपद प्रयागराज द्वारा लोन प्राप्तकर्ता की अपील डिस्मिस होने के पश्चात उच्च न्यायालय जनपद प्रयागराज द्वारा वर्ष 2016 में स्टे आर्डर प्रदान किया गया जिसमें बैंक द्वारा कभी भी स्टे हटाने की एप्लीकेशन नहीं दी गई अंतिम स्तर पर माननीय उच्च न्यायालय में मैं स्वयं ऑक्शन परचेजर प्रतिवादी संख्या 6 बनकर प्रस्तुत हुआ एवं 18 अक्टूबर 2022 को बैंक द्वारा WritC 42913/2016 डिस्मिस कर दी गई तथा सभी स्टे भी हटा दिए गए उसके पश्चात बैंक द्वारा औपचारिकता करते हुए जिलाधिकारी जनपद प्रयागराज तथा पुलिस कमिश्नर जनपद प्रयागराज को भौतिक कब्जे के संबंध में एक पत्र लिखकर अपनी जिम्मेदारियों की इतिश्री कर ली गई है 

आपसे अनुरोध है कि इसमें विशेष ध्यान देते हुए संबंधित सुलझे हुए बैंक अधिकारी को निर्देशित करें कि वह संबंधित जिलाधिकारी एवं पुलिस कमिश्नर जनपद प्रयागराज के माध्यम से संपत्ति का भौतिक कब्जा दिलवाना सुनिश्चित करें अथवा मेरे द्वारा जमा की गई धनराशि रुपए 35.10 लाख मात्र को 18% वार्षिक ब्याज की दर (1.50 प्रतिशत प्रतिमाह चक्रवृद्धि) के हिसाब से धनराशि वापस करने का कष्ट करें 

यहां पर यह भी ध्यान देने योग्य विषय है कि संपत्ति नीलामी से संबंधित मूल पत्रावली माननीय उच्च न्यायालय जनपद प्रयागराज में जमा है जिसे अभी तक बैंक ऑफ बड़ौदा जनपद प्रयागराज द्वारा वापस लेने संबंधी कोई भी प्रक्रिया प्रारंभ नहीं की गई है

As seen from the petition, it is noticed that M/s RD Industries with PAN AAUFR0362G had made remittance of Rs. 1.50 crore towards Advance Tax for A.Y. 2023-24 on 15.12.2022 erroneously on PAN AISPB2228D which belongs to Sri Bikram Behera. The jurisdiction in respect of Sri Bikram Behera vests with this office. It is seen that M/s RD Industries has filed a request along with supporting documents with ITO, Ward-11(1), Hyderabad. However, no petition or request letter or documents have been filed with this office in this regard. Since the tax credit of Rs. 1.50 crore is in the name of Sri Bikram Behera, the following documents are required to consider the request of PAN correction:
1.	No Objection letter, in original, from Sri Bikram Behera bearing his signature along with his identity proof containing his signature.
2.	Indemnity Bond to be given by M/s RD Industries for the amount of Rs. 1.50 crore.
3.	Details of the relationship between the complainant i.e. Sri Sujeet Kumar, M/s RD Industries as well as Sri Bikram Behera and also as to how and where the mistake w.r.t. remittance in another PAN occurred. 
4.	Any other information or proof in support of your request.
The process of PAN correction will be expedited on providing the above information / documents to this office.

It may please be noted that the issue in your case is not of remittance on an invalid PAN but on a distinct and a valid PAN belonging to another assessee, on which credit of a substantial amount of Rs. 1.50 crore is available in respect of the other assessee (circumstances for the blunder is still unknown). Therefore, the genuineness of the request being transfer of credit of the tax paid from one assessee to another should be clearly established with an express and unequivocal consent of such assessee i.e. Sri Bikram Behera in your case. Hence, the above documents are documents and information is sought to redress your grievance at the earliest.

In the new format of payment of taxes, there is no confirmation of the person unlike the earlier system, hence there was a mistake. We could not confirm the PAN before payment of taxes. આ કામના અરજદાશ્રીએ તાપી જિલ્લાના સોનગઢ તાલુકાના ચીમકુવા ગામે રહેતી પ્રેમીલાબેન સાથે સમાજના રીત રિવાજો મુજબ લગ્ન કરેલ હતા. પરંતુ અરજદાર દિપકભાઇ ગામીતનાઓ પોતાની પત્ની-પ્રેમીલાબેન સાથે અવાર નવાર ઝઘડો તકરાર કરતા હોવાથી પત્ની તથા સાસુ-સસરાનાઓ કંટાળી જઇ બંન્ને પક્ષના સાક્ષીપંચો રૂબરૂ સામાવાળા વકીલ પાસે બંન્ને પતિ પત્નીએ પોતાની મરજીથી વકીલશ્રી સુરેશભાઇ પાસે નોટરી કરાવી બંન્ને પતિ-પત્ની વચ્ચે છૂટ છેડા કરેલ છે.
બંન્ને પતિ પત્નીએ બંન્ને પક્ષોના પંચો/સાક્ષી રૂબરૂ વકીલ પાસે નોટરી કરી રાજીખુશી કાયદેસરના છુટ છેટા કર્યા બાદ અરજદાર ફરીથી પ્રેમીલાબેનને પત્ની તરીકે સ્વીકારવા માગે છે, પરંતુ પ્રેમીલાબેન અરજદાર સાથે પત્ની તરીકે રહેવા માંગતી નથી. આથી અરજદાર અનેક ગણી એકજ વિષયવાળી અરજીઓ PMO PG પોર્ટલના વેબ સાઇડ ઉપર કરતો હોવાનું તપાસ દરમ્યાન જણાય આવેલ છે. અરજદારને થયેલ છુટાછેડા બાબતે મનદુઃખ હોય તો યોગ્ય કોર્ટ રાહે દદ લેવા ત.ક.અમલદારે અવાર નવાર સમજ કરવા છતાં અરજદારે કોર્ટ રાહે કાર્યવાહી કરેલ નથી.
આ કામના અરજદારશ્રી દિપકભાઇ મણીલાલ ગામીત રહે, આમલગુડી તા.સોનગઢ જિ.તાપીનાઓને ઉપરોક્ત બાબતે અત્રેથી પ્રત્યુત્તરો પાઠવેલ છે.

At the outset it is observed that the CPGRAM has been already considered by this office in another CPGRAM-CBODT/E/2023/0001238.
Grievance of the petitioner relates to excess surcharge levied at 37 percent as against 15 percent applicable to her case, thereby raising a demand of Rs. 2,02,41,560/- (including interest u/s 234B and 234C) in order u/s 154 made in the case by CPC dated 11.10.2022. Applicant further submits that income of the assessee PAN AADTR0244G comprises only of dividend income and hence surcharge applicable in case of the assessee is at 15 percent as against surcharge currently levied at 37 percent in order u/s 154. In particular, Para-A of First Schedule of Finance Act, 2021 reading to the effect-Provided that in case where the total income includes any income by way of dividend or income chargeable under section 111A and section 112A of the Income-tax Act, the rate of surcharge on the amount of income-tax computed in respect of that part of income shall not exceed fifteen percent, is claimed to be applicable to the facts of his case. Applicant further submits that an appeal in Form-35 has been filed before CIT(A) dated 14.11.2022 against the order u/s 154 made in his case.
With respect to fact of the case, it is seen that petitioner essentially claims his nature of income only as dividend income for which provisions of Finance Act, 2021 as re-produced above is claimed to be applicable. Petitioner further submits an appeal in Form-35 filed before CIT(A) against above order u/s 154 by CPC.
Perusal of CPC 2.0 shows that an appeal in Form 35 is available in case of assessee vide acknowledgement no.-803289780141122 for AY 2021-22. Therefore, since the matter is pending for adjudication before CIT(A), no further action is feasible with this office with respect to CPGRAM including deletion of demand as requested in CPGRAM. Hence, it is proposed by this office that the CPGRAM may kindly be rejected, and treated as settled from this office.

remarks:
चूंकि शिकायत में उठाया गया मामले एसईसीसी या आवास प्लस डेटा बेस में शिकायतकर्ता का नाम मौजूद नहीं होने की स्थिति में मकानों के आवंटन के अनुरोध से संबन्धित है। यह सूचित किया जाता है कि पीएमएवाई-जी के तहत लाभार्थियों का दायरा SECC 2011 डेटा बेस और 2018 में किए गए आवास प्लस सर्वेक्षण के आधार पर अग्रिम रूप से तय किया गया है।इसलिए, सूची में संशोधन करना संभव नहीं है। पीएमएवाई-जी से संबधित विस्तृत जानकारी योजना के क्रियान्वयन का फ्रेमवर्क से प्राप्त कर सकते है जो वेबसाइट https://pmayg.nic.in/netiay/Uploaded/Guidelines-Hindi_book_final.pdfपर सार्वजनिक तौर से उपलब्ध है।
इस संबंध में यह सूचित किया जाता है कि आप अपना नाम अपने ग्राम पंचायत में दर्ज करा सकता है जिसका उपयोग भविष्य में वर्तमान लक्ष्य के पूरा होने पर आवास आवंटन के लिए किया जा सकता है।
अत उच्च प्राधिकारी से अनुरोध है कि शिकायत को नियत प्रक्रिया के अनुसार बंद करें।

In this case, penalty order u/s 271(1)(c) was passed on 23.05.2019, levying a penalty of Rs.2,06,230/-. Aggrieved by the penalty order, the assessee preferred an appeal before CIT(A) on 20.06.2019. Subsequently the assessee had opted for VSVS and filed Form1 on 21.03.2020. Since this case was eligible for VSVS, Form 5 was issued by the Pr.CIT-3, Chennai on 28.12.2020 with demand payable Nil.
	Further, order u/s 5(2) of VSVS Act was passed on 27.08.2021 with demand payable Nil and the same was uploaded in ITBA using manual order upload. Accounting of the order u/s 5(2) was closed by the CPC. Later, the assessee has sent mail on 12.01.2023 stating that even after passing give effect order u/s 5(2), the demand is still showing as pending to be paid in his account for the A.Y.2016-17 and requested to rectify the same. 
In view of the above, the penalty order u/s 271(1)(c) dated 23.05.2019 was revised u/s 154 on 12.01.2023 resulting in Nil demand with DIN:ITBA/PNL/M/154/2022-23/1048668951(1). Even after passing order u/s 154 the demand was not reduced and hence ticket vide no.1975438 was raised with ITBA helpdesk for reduction of demand in ITBA. The ticket was resolved on 23.01.2023 with solution given as ‘mentioned demand is cancelled as per CPC’. 
It was verified in the ITBA Recovery module that there was no outstanding demand pending with respect to penalty order u/s 271(1)(c) for the A.Y.2016-17. (Screen Shot attached).
 In view of the above, it is requested that the grievance may be treated as settled and disposed.

A refund of Rs. 1,50,000 was computed in ITBA system vide order u/s 251 dt. 05.11.19. 
 
But, instead of vacating penalty demand of Rs. 1,50,000 u/s 271B, AY 15-16 and allowing Refund of Rs. 1,50,000 to the assessee, the CPC has again adjusted Rs. 1,46,013 with penalty demand u/s 271B (AY 15-16) and had adjusted Rs. 3,987 with demand outstanding u/s 143(1) for AY 04-05.

Since the Jurisdictional Assessing Officer cannot access CPC_AO_Portal for vacating the infructuous demand outstanding against order u/s 271B in view of facts stated at Sl. 2 above, following INCIDENTS/e-mail letter to provide the solution/vacate the invalid demand outstanding in CPC-AO-Portal and to grant refund to the assessee as per order u/s 251 dt. 05.11.19 has been raised in ITBA system/CPC-Bangalore-Incident Nos:1146808/1230235/1254790/1298368 /1333879/1336898 /1479250/1769347/1960603/1965968 and e-mail letter to CPC dt. 28.12.22, 03.01.23 & 06.01.23

However, no appropriate solution in response to above Incidents/e-mail letter has been provided.In view of fact, the grievance may kindly be forwarded to CPC for vacating the infructuous demand outstanding against order u/s 271B for AY 15-16 and to grant the refund to assessee as per order u/s 251 dt. 05.11.19.

6.Employer verifies & approve it.

विषय रास्ता के सम्बन्ध में महोदय निवेदन है कि प्रार्थी मुकेश यादव पुत्र सभाजीत यादव उमाकान्त यादव पुत्र शिवचरन यादव ग्राम हिसामुद्दीनपुर पोस्ट सरायभाेगी परगना घिसुआ थाना एवं विकासखण्ड सुजानगंज तहसील मछली श्हार जनपद जौनपुर के मूल निवासी प्रार्थी के पडोसी लाल बहादुर सिंह व रत्नाकर सिंह राम अधार सिंह जबरन प्रार्थी का रास्ता बन्द कर दिए है जबकि राास्ता नीवन पर्ती पर है जिसका खाता संख्या 382 है जिसपर आधा रास्ता बना हुआ है तथा आधा इन लोगों द्वारा कब्जा कर लिया गया है। हमारे शिकायत करने पर ये लोग अधिकारियों से बताते हैं कि रास्ता खाता संख्या 384 व 385 पर है और कहते हैं कि इस पर सिविल न्यायालय में केश विचाराधीन है और जो भी अधिकारी आता है वो यही रिपोर्ट लगाके कोई कार्यवाही नहीं करते हैं।

Now PAN event marking for amalgamating and amalgamated company has been done through ITBA system and same has been successfully completed. However, credit of TDS of M/s Puriflair India Pvt. Limited (AABCP3762G) are still not being reflected with M/s Delair India Pvt. Limited (AAACD0156F). remarks:

બંન્ને પતિ પત્નીએ બંન્ને પક્ષોના પંચો/સાક્ષી રૂબરૂ વકીલ પાસે નોટરી કરી રાજીખુશી કાયદેસરના છુટ છેટા કર્યા બાદ અરજદાર ફરીથી પ્રેમીલાબેનને પત્ની તરીકે સ્વીકારવા માગે છે, પરંતુ પ્રેમીલાબેન અરજદાર સાથે પત્ની તરીકે રહેવા માંગતી નથી. આથી અરજદાર અનેક ગણી એકજ વિષયવાળી અરજીઓ PMO PG પોર્ટલના વેબ સાઇડ ઉપર કરતો હોવાનું તપાસ દરમ્યાન જણાય આવેલ છે. અરજદારને થયેલ છુટાછેડા બાબતે મનદુઃખ હોય તો યોગ્ય કોર્ટ રાહે દદ લેવા ત.ક.અમલદારે અવાર નવાર સમજ કરવા છતાં અરજદારે કોર્ટ રાહે કાર્યવાહી કરેલ નથી.
